old_problem: The simultaneous immediate/patrol consume flags were unexplained, and controller coverage, Windows evidence, physical applicability and recovery were unbound.
disposition_reason: The source explicitly fixes both flags and makes the full Cscript Patrol Scrub classification the decisive oracle. ED-03 permits the controller tuple map and evidence field/applicability table as runtime configuration; the vendor package/runbook must confirm this exact flag combination before execution. ED-16 retains FAE control, isolation and recovery, but these readiness gates do not require another engineering decision when the test refuses to run without that authority.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 15 and 16 and separately read actual next Pending row 17.
Read historical record 2421 and preserved exact identity/hashes.
Preserve both literal True flags; do not normalize them or infer patrol behavior from generic corrected-error text.
Require the untruncated Cscript transcript to explicitly classify Patrol Scrub Error for the injected target.
Use signed one-tuple-per-controller coverage and authoritative Windows/BMC/UEFI plus physical off-state evidence.
No BIOS change, injection, log clear, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Per-controller vendor-verified correctable Patrol Scrub injection
test_case.purpose: Exercise a CE through the package-defined Patrol Scrub path on every in-scope controller and prove the exact consumption classification, slot attribution, normal operation and no-light behavior.
required_package: Approved Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash and authoritative dual-flag semantics
Mandatory Patrol Scrub Cscript string/field contract
Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI slot oracle and indicator applicability
Abort, health and BIOS restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: After the vendor runbook confirms the exact dual-flag semantics, a qualified FAE on an isolated SUT captures `mc.dimminfo()`, verifies one signed tuple for the current controller and invokes `ei.injectMemError(socket, channel, dimm, sub_channel, rank=0, errType="ce", immConsume=True, PatrolConsume=True)` once. Preserve the complete Cscript classification and correlate Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI, normal-health and both physical off states before any next controller.
test_case.expected_result: Every in-scope controller has one mapped CE that the full Cscript output explicitly classifies as Patrol Scrub Error; records name the mapped physical slot, the system remains healthy, applicable UEFI agrees, and front-panel/DIMM lightpath stay off.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative support for both flags, complete controller coverage, explicit target-specific Patrol Scrub classification, correct slot/severity, normal operation and required off-state evidence. Generic CE/scrub keywords, unsupported flags, wrong target, missing controller, lamp assertion, instability or incomplete restoration is not PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT, approved harness/runbook and qualified FAE.
Preserve logs and verify tuple plus both flags before one injection.
Stop if Cscript does not prove Patrol Scrub, target/severity is wrong, errors repeat, a lamp asserts or health degrades.
No automatic retry or next target before complete recovery and evidence.
expected_evidence: Harness hash/runbook excerpt proving dual-flag semantics
Full mc.dimminfo and signed controller-to-tuple matrix
Per-target full Cscript Patrol Scrub classification
Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI slot attribution and physical off-state evidence
Health, BIOS restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong path/target, unexpected light or instability, preserve evidence and stop. Qualified engineering restores the approved BIOS state and verifies memory/platform health before any separately authorized rerun.
